sentences.text:
Learned A.G.A. in this backdrop states that vide order dated 16.1.2015 the court has only quash the proceedings of Case No. 11825 of 2010, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act but the first information report has not been quashed and till date the necessary petitioners are being harassed, even though the matter is matrimonial and the parties have settled their dispute.
6.

Mrs. Manju Thakur, learned A.G.A. on the instructions, submits that in the aforesaid case crime only petitioner nos. 1 to 4 were chargesheeted, which was subject matter to the F.I.R. but so far as petitioner nos. 5 to 8 is concerned their complicity has not been found and merely during investigation their names were dropped and they have been exonerated from all the charges,
therefore, the cause for filing the writ petition no more survives.
7.
In view of the categorical instructions, we are not inclined to keep the matter pending consideration.
8. Accordingly, in terms of the statement, the present writ petition is consigned to record.
